thread:
Hannah Kim: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we agreed to automate the runbook dry-run and add explicit handoff steps. I'd like to capture the small automation work + owners.
Diego Alvarez: Agree. Can we make the dry-run a small GitHub Action that runs the QA checklist against staging? That would reduce manual steps.
Marta Silva: I'm +1 on automation. But keep the runbook doc editable for non-PR urgent fixes. Automation should be opt-in per change.
Hannah Kim: Plan: two parts -> 1) runbook content edits (triage cmds, thresholds, escalation matrix, revert snippets) 2) CI dry-run automation that executes those triage commands in staging.
Diego Alvarez: I'll prototype the GH Action. Basic flow: checkout guarded branch -> deploy docs to staging site -> run scripted commands (curl metrics, canary probe, rbctl dry-run) -> post results back to PR. If any step fails, mark PR check as failed. Due: 2026-04-08.
Marta Silva: I'll own the runbook updates: add exact one-liners, decision tree, and a short "handoff" section with weekly owner rotation steps and pager IDs. Due: 2026-04-06.
oncall-bot: Created PD-901 "Runbook dry-run CI + owner handoff" and linked to postmortem.
Hannah Kim: Example triage commands to include (copy/paste):
```
# check eviction rate
curl -sS http://metrics.internal/kvcache?model=widget | jq .evictions_per_min
# canary probe
curl -sS http://canary.inference/v1/predict -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .status
# simulate route swap (dry-run)
rbctl route swap --model widget --from canary --to stable --dry-run
```
Diego Alvarez: For the GH Action I'll run rbctl with --dry-run and simulate metrics using the staging metrics endpoint. Also will publish a small PR comment summary: pass/fail + stdout for each command.
Marta Silva: Add thresholds inline next to commands: evictions_per_min >= 80 -> start triage; >=180 -> page runtime lead; canary status != 200 -> do not promote. Also add a one-line revert snippet under each change.
Hannah Kim: Escalation flow we agreed: oncall -> runtime lead -> infra -> eng manager (include pager IDs). Add copy/paste paging lines and a sample pager message.
Diego Alvarez: I will open a guarded branch runbook/ci-dryrun-automation and push the GH Action draft later today. Will tag @Marta for runbook PR.
runbook-bot: Created RB-4788 "CI dry-run for runbook PRs + add handoff appendix" assigned to Diego Alvarez and Marta Silva. Due 2026-04-08.
Marta Silva: I'll open the runbook PR from guarded branch runbook/incident-2425007890-edit and include a short QA checklist: 1) CI dry-run passes on PR 2) staging simulated eviction test 3) reviewer signoff from runtime.
Hannah Kim: Recap owners/dates: Marta -> runbook edits + PR (2026-04-06). Diego -> GH Action + PR commenter (2026-04-08). Hannah -> update postmortem action table when PRs are linked (2026-04-09).
Diego Alvarez: Quick note: automation will be opt-in with a label `runbook-dryrun` on PRs. If label missing, CI dry-run skip (so emergency edits can land faster).
Marta Silva: Good. Also adding a short "how to revert" paragraph and linking prior incidents 2409001111 in the runbook.
Hannah Kim: Please drop PR/ticket links here when created so I can update postmortem actions. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
